explicit-month.sql: SELECT ReferenceDate, IndexValue FROM analytics.vw_Cpi WHERE PeriodType = 'Month' AND ReferenceDate = @month
explicit-month.explanation: Reads the current monthly CPI index value for June 2025 from vw_Cpi.

explicit-year-average.sql: SELECT AVG(RatePercent) AS AvgRatePercent FROM analytics.vw_Sofr WHERE EffectiveDate >= @from AND EffectiveDate < @to
explicit-year-average.explanation: Reads the average SOFR rate for calendar year 2023 from vw_Sofr.

inflation-wording.sql: SELECT TOP (1) ReferenceDate, YearOverYearPct FROM analytics.vw_CpiMonthlyChange WHERE ReferenceDate >= @from AND ReferenceDate < @to ORDER BY ReferenceDate DESC
inflation-wording.explanation: Reads the most recent year-over-year CPI change within the last 12 months from vw_CpiMonthlyChange.

interest-rate-wording.sql: SELECT AsOfDate, Value FROM analytics.vw_LatestIndicator WHERE IndicatorCode = 'SOFR'
interest-rate-wording.explanation: Reads the single latest SOFR rate from vw_LatestIndicator.

volume-wording.sql: SELECT SUM(VolumeUsdBillions) AS TotalBorrowedUsdBillions FROM analytics.vw_Sofr WHERE EffectiveDate >= @from AND EffectiveDate < @to
volume-wording.explanation: Sums the daily SOFR trading volume in billions of dollars for March 2025 from vw_Sofr.

recent-window-not-refused.sql: SELECT ReferenceDate, YearOverYearPct FROM analytics.vw_CpiMonthlyChange WHERE ReferenceDate >= @from AND ReferenceDate < @to ORDER BY ReferenceDate
recent-window-not-refused.explanation: Reads the year-over-year CPI change for each of the last three months from vw_CpiMonthlyChange.

cross-dataset.sql: SELECT c.ReferenceDate, c.YearOverYearPct AS InflationPct, s.AvgRatePercent FROM analytics.vw_CpiMonthlyChange AS c JOIN (SELECT DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(EffectiveDate), MONTH(EffectiveDate), 1) AS MonthStart, AVG(RatePercent) AS AvgRatePercent FROM analytics.vw_Sofr WHERE EffectiveDate >= @from AND EffectiveDate < @to GROUP BY DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(EffectiveDate), MONTH(EffectiveDate), 1)) AS s ON s.MonthStart = c.ReferenceDate WHERE c.ReferenceDate >= @from AND c.ReferenceDate < @to ORDER BY c.ReferenceDate
cross-dataset.explanation: Puts year-over-year CPI change beside the monthly average SOFR rate for each month of 2025, by averaging SOFR to month starts and joining on the CPI reference month.

largest-change.sql: SELECT TOP (1) DATEADD(month, -1, m.MonthStart) AS FromMonth, m.MonthStart AS ToMonth, m.PrevAvgRate, m.AvgRate, m.AvgRate - m.PrevAvgRate AS ChangeInPercentagePoints FROM (SELECT MonthStart, AvgRate, LAG(AvgRate) OVER (ORDER BY MonthStart) AS PrevAvgRate FROM (SELECT DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(EffectiveDate), MONTH(EffectiveDate), 1) AS MonthStart, AVG(RatePercent) AS AvgRate FROM analytics.vw_Sofr WHERE EffectiveDate >= @from AND EffectiveDate < @to GROUP BY DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(EffectiveDate), MONTH(EffectiveDate), 1)) AS monthly) AS m WHERE m.PrevAvgRate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ABS(m.AvgRate - m.PrevAvgRate) DESC
largest-change.explanation: Averages SOFR to each month of 2025, compares each month with the one before it, and returns the single largest move together with both months and both rates.

peak.sql: SELECT TOP (1) ReferenceDate, IndexValue FROM analytics.vw_Cpi WHERE PeriodType = 'Month' AND ReferenceDate >= @from AND ReferenceDate < @to ORDER BY IndexValue DESC
peak.explanation: Reads the monthly CPI index values for 2024 from vw_Cpi and returns the month with the highest index value.

annual-average.sql: SELECT ReferenceYear, AnnualValue FROM analytics.vw_CpiAnnual WHERE ReferenceYear = @year
annual-average.explanation: Reads the annual average CPI value for 2022 from vw_CpiAnnual.

collection-health.sql: SELECT SourceCode, CollectionDate, Attempts, Failures, LastStatus FROM analytics.vw_CollectionHealth WHERE CollectionDate >= @from AND CollectionDate < @to ORDER BY CollectionDate, SourceCode
collection-health.explanation: Reads collection health for each source over the past 7 days ending today from vw_CollectionHealth.

latest-figure.sql: SELECT TOP (1) ReferenceDate, IndexValue FROM analytics.vw_Cpi ORDER BY ReferenceDate DESC
latest-figure.explanation: Reads the most recent monthly CPI index value from vw_Cpi, ordered by reference date descending.

half-open-range.sql: SELECT AVG(RatePercent) AS AvgRatePercent FROM analytics.vw_Sofr WHERE EffectiveDate >= @from AND EffectiveDate < @to
half-open-range.explanation: Reads the average SOFR rate for January 2025 from vw_Sofr.

follow-up-referent.sql: SELECT AnnualValue FROM analytics.vw_CpiAnnual WHERE ReferenceYear = @year
follow-up-referent.explanation: Reads the annual average CPI for the year before the one just asked about, 2021, from vw_CpiAnnual.
